Name: Equine Explosion - Horse Retexture Conversions for Alternative Textures
Author: counterklock
Description:
[size=5][b]ABOUT:[/b][/size]

This mod is a massive collection of horse textures from many popular horse mods, converted to Alternative Textures. Each pack is standalone, meaning you can mix and match packs and play with just your favorites, or have [i]All The Horses Ever[/i]. There are over 150+ horse textures to choose from!

This mod [i][u][b]REQUIRES[/b][/u][/i] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures
[/url]. After installing this mod, use the Scissors tool on your horse(s) to bring up the AT texture menu and search (manually or via keywords) for the textures you want to use.

If you pair this with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt N Skin[/url], you can use the Wild Horse mechanic to catch and keep multiple horses. Please note that you cannot load Adopt N Skin textures through Alternative Textures, and vice versa.

Feel free to make suggestions if you find horse textures you think would fit this mod! I'm especially focused on older horse replacements (ie. XNB and older CP mods). I want to bring as many horse replacements up to date as possible, with permission from the original mod authors.

[size=5][b]KEYWORDS:[/b][/size]

[code]All horses have been tagged with my prefix, the name of the mod, the source mod, whether they have a saddle, saddle color, the original variation name if applicable,
and the horse coat color and/or pattern.

To use the AT search function, the keywords must be used in this specific order.
 For example, if you wanted to find all the Flame Horses that have no saddle, you would type 'FlameHorses NoSaddle'.
 If you wanted to find all saddled palominos from Equine Explosion, you would type 'EquineExplosion Saddled Palomino'
 If you wanted to find all fantasy horses, you would type 'EquineExplosion Fantasy'

[ALL KEYWORDS]
|| Main
 CK - All of my AT content is tagged with 'CK' - Short for 'Counterklock'; This will differentiate all of the horses I've converted/created for AT, not just Equine Explosion
 EquineExplosion - All horses are tagged with this keyword; this will differentiate the Equine Explosion horses from any other horse AT packs you might have

|| Source Mod
 RealLifeHorses - Source mod; use to find all horses from Real Life Horses
 BetterHorses - Source mod; Use to find all horses from Better Horses
 SoManyHorses - Source mod; Use to find all horses from So Many Horses
 FlameHorses - Source mod; Use to find all horses from Flame Horses
 Epona - Source mod; Use to find Epona
 Arvak - Source mod; Use to find Arvak

|| Saddle Status
 NoSaddle - The horse is tackless
 Saddled - The horse is saddled
 SadleBlack - The saddle is black
